# Versions of: Person Graph

1 published version of [Person Graph: one picture of what we have been building, people and their agents with their own keys and repositories, links that count only both ways, kinds of link from "real" to "vouch to hire", groups as centres of gravity, countersigned claims, anonymous personas, a check for re-identification, all done through each person's own Claude, with mock-ups of the site and a simulation of 150 people and 40 fake accounts that shows why two-way links make bad actors cheap to spot](../person-graph.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
